answer.summary: The app crashed during Spring startup, about 40s after launch, after running Flyway migrations. The /api/me health check then timed out with no HTTP response. The ERROR stack trace is cut off in the excerpt, so the root cause is not visible. The PR adds a new migration and changes persistence code, so a deterministic startup failure from the change is plausible, but this is low confidence and worth checking the full log for the exception.
